octen.note: Official Octen hosted MCP server. Uses OAuth — on first connection you are prompted to sign in and authorize in the browser; no API key to paste and nothing installed locally. The tools query parameter narrows this connection to the four generally available tools, so the roster a user sees is one they can actually call. Tools: search (focused current web search), news_search (recent events and reporting), broad_search (multi-angle coverage from generated sub-queries), extract (clean structured content from URLs).
